description:
The TPC-DS stdout fix (commit 3911fd3a) applied patches to enable streaming
data generation but lacks documentation equivalent to what TPC-H has.

TPC-H has a comprehensive PATCHES.md file documenting the stdout patch
and crediting gregrahn/tpch-kit. TPC-DS needs the same treatment to:

1. Document the patches applied for future maintainers
2. Credit the original fix author (gregrahn/tpcds-kit commit 7992dbb)
3. Help users understand the streaming capability exists

This was identified during code review of the stdout fix implementation.
